text.title: Incident Comms Templates Internal External — Decision Tree

decision-tree.root-question: Does the org run a paid service or a published SLA, see at least one P1 / P2 per quarter, and have a named incident commander on rotation?

branch.when: paid_service_or_sla == false OR p1_p2_per_quarter < 1 OR commander_named == false
branch.conclusion: Skip. Pre-launch or no commander: defer until customers and an on-call rotation exist; a regulated org uses the regulator's template.

branch.when: paid_service_or_sla == true AND p1_p2_per_quarter >= 1 AND commander_named == true
branch.question: Does the severity x audience matrix have a row for the declared severity, and are the four templates present with `last_drilled` within 90 days?

branch.conclusion: Block. Complete the matrix and the four-template bundle before any send.
Drill the stale templates before they are used as defaults; fix retired components and recipients.

branch.when: matrix_row_for_severity == true AND templates_present == 4 AND max_last_drilled_days <= 90
branch.question: Was the first external post inside the severity's deadline, and does every update end with a next-update time?

branch.conclusion: Post now, even "no change"; add the next-update time; keep the interval timer.

branch.question: Is the external draft free of unconfirmed cause, blame, internal names and unresolved tokens?

branch.conclusion: Strip cause and system names; move the hypothesis to the internal post.
Block the send until every token is filled.
Send to the audiences in the matrix row; commander or comms lead approves the rendered text.
